[b]September 23-October 1, 2026: Red October[/b]

As discord tore through the government of Thýven following the collapse of the Mendenavist order in Tharkønn, the cities of Malberg, Droen, and Jassel, considering the lack of order and lack of ability of the central government to ensure the stability of Thýven, would declare independence from the Principate of Gossen, to form the Free City-Confederation of Gossen. 

Emboldened by the communistic movements in the region, factory and farm workers would initiate a strike against the companies in the region, threatening to topple the IDF commanders and the Bank of Gossen if the government of Thýven did not adhere to the demands of the Peoples Party of North Thýven.

The protests would rock the officials in Tharkønn as an emergency session of the Gøsfodde would be called to determine the ability of the 1865 constitution to restore order. However, prominent jurists and scholars would state that the 1865 constitution which established a semi-liberal order in Thýven had no mechanism to protect from separatist movements beyond the usage of military force, something that had been ruled out during the protests of early September.

Once again Piter Drømm would be sent to handle the affair, meeting with the leaders of the strikes he would come to the conclusion that the only way to ensure national unity was to permit the formation and recognition of the Free City-Confederation under the bounds of national law. Citing the ancient Confederal States of the Thrømm during the time of the early kings in the 10th and 11th centuries. 

However, the hard-core Mendenavists, horrified by the idea of permitting openly communist factions in Thýven, would attempt to subvert government operations by a motion of no-confidence, thereby dismantling the Gøsfodde and shuttering the government. The motion, deeply unpopular, would fail to reach majority, being struck down immediately by the nobility. 

In the meantime the Baron Lenstahl, needing to secure the Bank of Gossen, would order the IDF to protect crucial bank assets, freezing withdrawals, and laying off bank staff as he moved to temporarily commandeer the bank's board through his own executive means as the head of the Bank of Tharkønn. The freezing of withdrawals would lead to several attempted bank runs as the Prince of Gossen warned of an economic disaster in Gossen. 

It had become clear to many that power had been too quickly centralised without lawful and universal parameters under the patriarchate, thereby destabilising Thýven even further rather than restoring Imperial Order. Patriotism had given way to disillusionment.

[quote=the_crystalline_empire;60679239][b]September 22, 2025: Save the World First, Orthodoxy Second.[/b]

The ultimatum by the USO shook the government of Thýven, nuclear weapons aimed now at Thývens shores was unthinkable, and indeed shook even the most loyal Mendenavist. Yet it seemed to most that the patriarch was set upon his track.

As a result a fracture would appear in the hours following the ultimatum as loyal Mendenavists sought quickly a resolution to the matter, attempting to rapidly pass legislation to revoke the order, however, hardliners proved a major block on any revocation of the order, utilising the ideal of Patriarchal Infallibility to defend the actions of the patriarch.

In the meantime the nobility of Thýven, fed up with the shenanigans of the church would move to back an emergency coalition formed by the Doge of the Free Republic of Knygta and Deyn, Albus Capricorn, who had vowed to end the blockade within 24 hours, and dethrone the patriarch.

However the promise came with a caveat, the formation of a neutral emergency government under the governance of solely the Gøsfodde with Capricorn as the temporary head of state, something which few nobles were willing to accept, fearing that the more liberal Capricorn would attempt to use his Republic's wealth to influence the trajectory of the government.

Unable to verbally command the legislature, Capricorn thus moved to assert his power physically, ordering the Merchant Navy of the Free Republic of Knygta and Deyn to be raised to full combat mode with plans to face the blockade, hoping to break it internally.

While to some this was a laughable attempt to gain legitimacy under a heavily centralised Mendenavist government, it became clear that Capricorn was serious in his threats as the Navy of the Republic quickly made its way to the rear of the blockade, armed and ready to fire. Furthermore was the threat of Knygta and Deyn using its own rocket arsenal and SRBM arsenal against Thýven itself to restore order.

Thus, as the navy made its appearance on the blockade, the Gøsfodde would assemble under the guise of preventing a potentially destabilising civil war, led by Piter Drømm a series of declarations were made.

[list]
1. The Mendenavist government is stripped of its powers under the 1865 constitution
2. The Patriarchate will be stripped of legislative and executive powers effective immediately.
3. The armed forces of Thýven will be temporarily recalled from all international positions.
4. An emergency government will be formed under the leadership of the Gøsfodde, acting as executive and legislative.
[/list]

With the orders being issued and promulgated, the government of Thýven would signal internationally that it would be lifting the blockade for The stability and freedom of Erene, along with a two week period of full withdrawal of all armed forces from centres of conflict in the White Strait and the Baliwick Sea.

[quote=united_hydronia;60674605][spoiler=[b]Operation Red Falcon: Phase 2[/b]]

Now that Hydronia had successfully established two zones within Valddera, it would be time to actually do something with those zones. As agreed with the Valdderan government, the major urban areas would be placed back under local authorities, in exchange for unobstructed access to the highways that ran through the cities. Whilst these cities would be handed back over to the Valdderan government, Hydronian forces would still expand into the surrounding environment to form a secure base form which to launch an assault.

The two Hydronian zones would now be used for two different attacks. Zone 1 in the north would stage an attack on ISV forces in the west, whereas Zone 2 in the south would launch an attack against the new ISV-backed movement that had captured the eastern provinces.

The zone 1 attack would use a strategy of encirclement to isolate pockets of ISV soldiers. Beginning with an overnight incursion into lightly defended ISV-influenced territories, Hydronian forces would roll through the Valdderan countryside in tanks and armoured vehicles. They would use electronic jamming units to disrupt the radar of the ISV, and therefore their vision. Once the ISV had been blinded, surface-to-surface missiles would be fired towards ISV positions, before the survivors are picked off by artillery, machine gunners and snipers. This tactic would be used to surround the ISV and their urban strongholds, before slowly closing in and using superior manpower to crush the ISV. Urban centers would be bombarded with artillery fire until the ISV were killed or gave in, Hydronia has no tolerance for terrorism.

The Zone 2 attack would go differently. The ISV movement in the east would be more heavily fortified, meaning that the resistance Hydronian troops would face would be much harsher. The first thing to be done in the assault would be the surrounding and hopeful destruction of the enclave that had been formed by the ISV. Hydronian forces would initially use similar tactics to the zone 1 offensive, but there would be one alteration. To prevent an ISV attack from the north against Hydronian forces located in the corridor between the areas of the ISV, the army would build up a massive defensive formation along the northern border. This would both protect Hydronia from an attack during the encirclement of the enclave, as well as build a base for the zone 2 army's second attack, which would be against the main territory of the ISV. The encirclement would go the same as the encirclements of the zone 1 offensive, with rounding the ISV forces into central urban areas being the goal.

The new democratic movement that had sprung up in Valddera would surprise Hydronia, but phenomenon like this were to be expected from an unstable country. This also put Hydronia in a very sticky situation. Hydronia has obligations to the legitimate communist government, yet a democratic regime would favour Hydronia's diplomatic interests more. To solve this problem, president Bozkan would alter Hydronia's [i]official[/i] motives. In a speech, he would state that Hydronia is officially in favour of neither the government nor the democratic rebels, reinforcing the fact that Hydronia's sole goal in this war as of now was to rid Erene of the ISV's reign of terror. Whilst Hydronia would continue to cooperate with the Valdderan government, no military aid would be sent to either side. Bozkan would also state that Hydronian forces will try to avoid direct combat with both the red army and the democratic army.

Cobra team would for now refrain from direct military combat against the ISV, their mission would be far more crucial. Stationed in their covert enclave of territory, they would engage in cyber and electronic warfare in an attempt to locate the leader of the ISV, Hassan Al-Amin. Radio communications would be intercepted, jihadist internet forums scoured and cyberattacks launched in an attempt to gain any information on Hassan's whereabouts. Whilst this was happening, cobra team would also take to the skies at night in a stealth helicopter. This helicopter would be fitted with thermal imaging and radar, then flown over Valddera's northern and eastern areas to find possible locations too.

The Democratic Republic of United Hydronia pushes forward the following resolution for vote at the IA General Assembly.
[spoiler=[b]IA Resolution Regarding The Situation In Valddera[/b]]
[i]Recognising[/i] the desperate need for peace and stability in Valddera

[i]Recognising[/i] that the Islamic State of Valddera (ISV) poses a serious threat to world peace and stability

[i]Reaffirming[/i] the IAs commitments to peace, stability and sovereignty for all inhabitants of Erene

Hearby [i]establishes[/i] the IA peacekeeping mission to Valddera (IAPMV)

Within this mission, the following will apply:
[list]
[*]All willing IA member nations may deploy troops to participate in the IAPMV. These nations will be referred to as IAPMV donators
[*]The IAPMV will establish humanitarian safety zones around as many major settlements are accessible to deployed peacekeepers
[*]The IAPMV will establish a shipping safety zone around Valdderas international waters and EEZ to protect international trade from the ISV
[*]IAPMV peacekeepers are permitted to defend these zones with any forces necessary, provided they stay within the bounds of international law
[*]The IAPMV will provide a steady supply of food, water and other essential items to fulfill the basic human rights. These supplies will be sourced from IAPMV donators
[*]The IAPMV is not permitted to engage in offensive armed combat with any entity in Valddera, force is only permitted in a defensive situation
[*]Donators to the IAPMV will refrain from engaging in hostilities with each other within Valddera. They will act as a coherent army to ensure the security of Valddera, not to impose foreign interests on the country
[*]The IAPMV will cooperate with the legitimate Valdderan government on all matters
[*]The IA General Assembly retains the right to remove or block an IA member nation from participation in the IAPMV through a vote.
[/list]
[/spoiler]

[i]Vote will be held on discord[/i]
